column1: # Unreadable code fed to a local shell (🛡️, 2026-10-26): a non-literal piped into sh or bash, root or not, runs what the
# hook cannot read, and a non-root shell can still run every command the hook refuses one by one (incus exec, a
# working-tree nix build, ssh to the corporate bare-metal). A pipe from an echo or printf literal is judged as code, like
# a here-string. Measured before the rule: 0 such pipes in 27,539 distinct session commands over 14 days.
# Columns, tab-separated: want, today (develop 9eb3ee37, measured), cwd (@fixtures = the redirect fixtures), cmd.
